# BlurEffect

- Inherits [`PostEffect`](posteffect.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("BlurEffect")`

Blurs the whole picture of the world, for example behind a pause menu. The interface is drawn after it and stays sharp. When several apply, their sizes combine as the square root of the sum of their squares: two blurs of 8 make one of about 11.3, not 16.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Size` | `number` | `24` | read/write | How far the light of a pixel is spread, in pixels of a picture 1,080 lines tall. It scales with the window, so a blur looks the same at any resolution. 0 is no blur and costs nothing. 100 is the maximum and leaves no detail. |
